name: ui-gallery
description: Images and videos as thumbnail tiles with a lightbox (previous/next, keyboard, swipe, video player); declarative items, editable and sortable.

descriptions.--ui-gallery-tile-size: Minimum width of a tile (columns fill the row).
descriptions.--ui-gallery-tile-bg: Background of a tile (visible without thumbnail).
descriptions.--ui-gallery-tile-color: Text colour of a tile without thumbnail.
descriptions.--ui-gallery-object-fit: How a thumbnail fills its tile.
descriptions.--ui-gallery-hover-scale: Zoom of a thumbnail on hover.
descriptions.--ui-gallery-play-size: Size of the play mark on videos.
descriptions.--ui-gallery-drop-color: Outline of the drop target while sorting.
